SUMMARY
***UNIQUE THREE BEDROOM APARTMENT with PRIVATE ROOF TERRACE and marketed with NO CHAIN***

The property briefly comprises of an entrance hall, reception room, THREE GENEROUSLY SIZED BEDROOMS with EN-SUITE, separate kitchen & stairs leading to a PRIVATE ROOF TERRACE!

**EARLY VIEWING ADVISED**

DESCRIPTION
Barnard Marcus are delighted to bring to market this TRULY UNIQUE THREE BEDROOM APARTMENT complete with PRIVATE ROOF TERRACE, marketed with NO ONWARD CHAIN and ideally situated within a stones' throw of PECKHAM RYE STATION which offers services into LONDON BRIDGE, CLAPHAM JUNCTION, BLACKFRIARS & VICTORIA all in UNDER 20 MINUTES!

The property briefly comprises of an entrance hall, reception room, THREE GENEROUSLY SIZED BEDROOMS with EN-SUITE, separate kitchen & stairs leading to a PRIVATE ROOF TERRACE!

Located in the beating heart of vibrant Peckham, this top floor flat at Central Buildings offers an ideal base for first-time buyers seeking an energetic urban lifestyle. Peckham Rye station is just a two-minute walk away, providing rapid Zone 2 rail and Overground connections to London Bridge in 10 minutes and Victoria in 12 minutes. Right on your doorstep, Rye Lane boasts a bustling mix of trendy rooftop bars, indie cafes, and supermarkets like Lidl. With the creative hubs of Peckham Levels and the open spaces of Peckham Rye Park nearby, everything you need is within arm's reach.

Please note that an AML fee is chargeable to the buyer once an offer is accepted to cover the cost of carrying out the required identity and anti-money laundering checks. Once these checks have been completed, the fee cannot be refunded, even if the property purchase does not go ahead.
